"""RoboPaint 中: camera-based calibration and four longitudinal brush strokes.
This file records the code executed in order in the single live episode.
"""
import sys,json,time,math
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
Q=np.array([-3.98743083e-7,1.,-3.55532393e-7,-2.86572686e-8])
last=r.get_obs(cameras=['side_cam'],video='none')
command=last.group('tcp_pose',now=True).copy()
seq=0

def send(points,note='',cams=['practice_cam'],fps=5):
    global last,command,seq
    a=np.asarray(points)
    if a.shape[1]==3:a=np.column_stack([a,np.tile(Q,(len(a),1))])
    for start in range(0,len(a),180):
        part=a[start:start+180]
        seq+=1
        np.save(f'/app/output/actions_{seq:03d}.npy',part)
        last=r.submit('ee_pose',part,dt=.05,cameras=cams,video='frames',video_fps=fps,note=note)
        last.save(f'/app/output/run_{seq:03d}')
        for cam,im in last.last.items():Image.fromarray(im).save(f'/app/output/latest_{cam}.png')
        command=part[-1].copy()
        print('SEND',seq,'steps',last.meta.get('control_steps'),'tip',last.group('tcp_pose',now=True)[:3], 'plan',last.meta.get('plan'),flush=True)
        if last.stopped or last.done:raise RuntimeError(str(last.meta))
    return last

def move(xyz,speed=.04,hold=.3,cams=['practice_cam']):
    global command
    n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(np.array(xyz)-command[:3])/speed/.05)))
    p=np.linspace(command[:3],xyz,n+1)[1:]
    p=np.vstack([p,np.tile(xyz,(int(hold/.05),1))])
    return send(p,'position and settle',cams=cams)

def observe(cams=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],depth=False):
    global last
    last=r.get_obs(cameras=cams,depth=depth)
    last.save('/app/output/obs')
    for cam,im in last.last.items():Image.fromarray(im).save(f'/app/output/latest_{cam}.png')
    return last
PY
